author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read the Postfix mail log, forwarded over syslog to the data collector with rsyslog or syslog-ng, or shipped from maillog_file. Refused and held mail, delivery results and queue entries go to Email, and SMTP AUTH sign-ins and failures go to Auth.
notes:
Setup:
- Forward the Postfix host's mail log (the mail facility) to the data collector with rsyslog or syslog-ng, or set maillog_file and ship that file.

Field mapping:
- To Email: mail refused or held by smtpd, postscreen or cleanup's header and body checks (event_type reject, discard or hold; reject and discard are BLOCKED, hold QUARANTINED), with the sender, recipient, client address and the reply as the reason.
- To Email: delivery results from smtp, lmtp, local, virtual and pipe (event_type delivery), with the recipient, relay, dsn and status, where sent is DELIVERED and deferred, bounced and expired keep Postfix's status in event_metadata.
- To Email: qmgr's queue entry (event_type queued) with the sender and size.
- To Auth: SMTP AUTH sign-ins (client= with sasl_username) and failures (SASL ... authentication failed) with the user and address.
- A failure names the user only from Postfix 3.9.
- Each line stands alone: one message spans several lines tied by its queue ID, which goes to event_metadata, so search on queue_id to follow a message.
- Service names such as postfix/submission/smtpd are read.

Time:
- A BSD syslog time has no year or zone and is read as UTC; keep the host on UTC, or forward with RFC 3339 times (rsyslog's forwarding format), whose zone is kept.

Sources and licenses:
- Postfix publishes no field reference, so these parsers follow the format strings in Postfix's source (smtpd_check.c, postscreen_smtpd.c, cleanup_message.c, opened.c, log_adhoc.c, smtpd.c and smtpd_sasl_glue.c; three are linked) and the log examples in its README files.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in those shapes.

Testing:
- Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-16 (101 of 101 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs), and the parent's confirm string picked the same lines there.
- Each child also passed Run Test as a separate parser under its parent (101 of 101 fields, each line taken in 5 of 5 runs).
- No built-in parser claimed these lines or the unclaimed ones.

Known gaps:
- Connect, disconnect, message-id and removed lines aren't claimed.
